about.title: Nevada City Wrongful Death Claims
about.longDescription: In a town of about 3,152 people, a sudden death is felt by nearly everyone, not just the household left behind. If that loss came from another person's carelessness, California law allows certain family members to bring a civil wrongful death claim, entirely separate from anything the district attorney may pursue. Nevada County's final 2025 records list 11 injury collisions and 14 people hurt in Nevada City, with no traffic deaths that year; crashes here concentrate along SR-49 and SR-20 and tend to cluster on Monday afternoons between 4 and 6 p.m. Fatal harm in the foothills can also arise from medical errors, unsafe property, or job-site incidents, so these claims are never limited to the road. We handle wrongful death claims on contingency. Standing goes first to a spouse or domestic partner and children, and the filing window is generally two years from the date of death, shorter when a public agency is involved. Talking with us early keeps every option open.

whyChoose.title: Why Nevada City Families Choose Us

items.title: Clarity on Who May File
items.desc: California limits wrongful death standing to a spouse or domestic partner and children first, then certain dependents and heirs. We can sort out who in your family has the right to bring the claim.

items.title: Deadlines Explained Plainly
items.desc: Most claims must be filed within two years of the date of death, and the window shrinks considerably when a city, county, or state agency is involved. We will address which clock applies to your situation right away.

items.title: No Fee Unless You Recover
items.desc: We handle wrongful death cases on contingency. Your family can seek funeral costs, lost financial support, and compensation for lost love, companionship and guidance without paying anything up front.

items.question: Our loved one died in a crash on SR-49 just outside Nevada City. Does that change the claim?
items.answer: Not in terms of your family's right to file, but it can affect the details. State highways like SR-49 and SR-20 fall under Caltrans, and if a road condition contributed to the crash, a government entity might be a party. Claims against public agencies carry a much shorter deadline than the standard two years, so it is worth speaking with us soon.

items.question: Can we bring a wrongful death claim if there is also a criminal case?
items.answer: Yes. A wrongful death claim is a civil action brought by the family, while a criminal case is brought by the state and decided on a different standard. The two proceed independently, and the outcome of one does not determine the other. We can explain how timing between them may play out.

items.question: What losses can a Nevada City family actually recover?
items.answer: California allows recovery for funeral and burial expenses, the financial support your loved one would have provided, and the loss of their love, companionship, and guidance. Every family's circumstances differ, and no attorney can promise a particular result. What we do is document each of these losses carefully so nothing is overlooked.
